analyst_view.overall: Moreirense (9th, 14 points) host Santa Clara (4th, 21 points) on matchday 12, both coming off league defeats before the international break. Santa Clara's back four is almost entirely new: Pedro Pacheco is suspended (counted by the numbers), Emanuel Moreira is also suspended and Guilherme Romao injured (neither counted), so Record and Dia de Jogo expect Ythallo and Henrique Silva in central defence with Kamika at full-back, Lucas Soares the only regular left, and a youth centre-back promoted for cover. Their keeper Lucas Franca is counted as out, and midfielder Pedro Ferreira may return with a face mask after a broken nose. Moreirense still miss Joao Veloso (counted), but Tiago Andrade is fit and Alexandre Parsemain is close to a return after an injury with Martinique, while the numbers count him out. Referee Luis Carlos Mateus Filipe (6.3 cards a game in three games) is already counted; I lean higher on Moreirense's attack because of the Santa Clara absences the numbers don't count.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.0 goals and already add about 6% each to Moreirense for Pacheco's ban and keeper Lucas Franca being out, and take about 7% off them for Parsemain. I go up to about 2.14 because Moreira's ban and Romao's injury are not in the numbers, so Santa Clara field a makeshift back four, and Parsemain may well be back; I keep it modest because Santa Clara have conceded little this season.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners, split almost evenly, and already trim both sides for low recent corner counts (Moreirense 17 and Santa Clara 19 in their last six). A new Santa Clara back line might concede a few more set pieces, but Moreirense have not been winning many corners lately, so I stay at 8.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.6 cards, already adding about 5% for referee Luis Carlos Mateus Filipe (6.3 a game in a small sample) and 6% for Santa Clara's 22 cards in their last six, and trimming Moreirense for only 9. Inexperienced Santa Clara defenders could be drawn into fouls, but that is a hunch and the referee is already counted, so I stay at 5.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.6 shots, already adding about 7% to Moreirense and 6% to Santa Clara for recent shooting and defending. I add a little more, to about 23.5, because Moreirense should test a Santa Clara defence missing three regulars, only one of them counted, and Parsemain and Tiago Andrade give them more attacking options.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.4 shots on target, trimmed for both sides' modest recent accuracy. With Santa Clara starting Ythallo and Henrique Silva together in central defence and missing Moreira and Romao on top of the counted Pacheco, Moreirense should get some clearer chances than usual, so I go up mildly to about 6.7.
